name: [UPD] Volleyball Legends
desc:
BECOME THE KING OF THE COURT in Volleyball Legends!!

🏐🔥🔥FAST-PACED 6v6 Volleyball
Play a pickup Volleyball game with friends OR challenge anyone in a RANKED match

🎮CONTROLS:
Bump, Spike in Midair - CLICK [PC], RT [CONSOLE]
Set, Block in Midair - Q [PC], LT [CONSOLE]
Dive - CTRL [PC], X [CONSOLE]

❓HOW TO SERVE:
Once it is your turn to serve, click on screen (RT on console). Click again to choose power.
You can jump and spike the ball (tilt to change direction of the ball).
You can also let the ball drop to bump serve the ball in.

Premium benefits: Premium players receive +10% Yen

New updates weekly Saturdays at 11:30am EST!
Follow the game so you don't miss out!

💛LIKE, FAVORITE, and JOIN the group for REWARDS!
